name: Investigation Data Record 12 Choice
definition: Specifies the data elements related to the response to an investigation request.

DebitAuthorisation.name: Debit Authorisation
DebitAuthorisation.definition: Indicates if the debit authorisation is granted or not.

Compensation.name: Compensation
Compensation.definition: Indicates the compensation due for the request.

Valuation.name: Valuation
Valuation.definition: Indicates the compensation due for the request.

Confirmation.name: Confirmation
Confirmation.definition: Provides confirmation that a payment has debited or credited an account.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Provides the status of a payment that has not yet debited or credited an account.

TransactionData.name: Transaction Data
TransactionData.definition: Provides data related to a request.

ResponseNarrative.name: Response Narrative
ResponseNarrative.definition: Provides additional information about the response in narrative form.
